method: Read-only CAFF/XML inspection with default ArtMesh forms mapped through neutral Warp grids. Rotation is intentionally excluded from the neutral geometry comparison because its center key changed from +1 to 0 degrees.
conclusion: The requested Z center, four clips, Head_XY_Base hierarchy, and Jaw_Open keys are present. Neutral geometry is preserved to sub-0.01 coordinate rounding after the intended reparenting; no unintended mesh topology, source image, parameter, or existing physics changes were found.
limits: This is structural and numerical inspection of the saved CMO3, not a Cubism or runtime visual review.
The jaw endpoint is an intended new deformation and is excluded from the neutral preservation comparison.
Side/back hair and neck motion are later stages and are not claimed by this checkpoint audit.
The ahoge shape remains the known no-op training implementation and was not changed.
